raw.name: Rawblocks
raw.desc: Sixty-six works, almost all from Oct 30, 2022 to Mar 15, 2023. Three galleries, each a run of consecutive dates.

abs.name: Abstract
abs.dates: Mar 30 to Apr 4, 2022 (from the collector's earlier gallery)
abs.desc: Fifty-two works with no per-work dates, shown in title order. Read by number, the series moves from layered bands toward thrown, scribbled and swirled marks, and the two galleries follow that turn.

oth.name: Other nnxyz
oth.desc: Forty-five works outside the named series: pieces made for occasions, and the numbered masks of 2023 and 2024.

scr.name: Scrimshaw
scr.desc: Twenty-six works, the earliest in the collection. One gallery.
